Ticket peer review, minus the noise.

**Downloads**
- `slicecheck-skill.zip`: the skill folder for Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other tools that support SKILL.md. Unzip it into your tool's skills folder.
- `slicecheck-chatgpt-kit.zip`: build a SliceCheck Custom GPT. Steps in `SETUP.md` inside.
- `slicecheck-copilot-kit.zip`: build a SliceCheck agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Steps in `SETUP.md` inside.

Setup for every option is in the [README](https://github.com/aniubom/SliceCheck#use-it-inside-your-ai).
